summary.text: Irene Shin is a Democratic member of the Virginia House of Delegates representing District 8, which covers Fairfax County and Herndon.
Irene Shin has been a member since 2022.

paragraphs.text: According to the House profile, Irene Shin was born in Glendale, California.
Irene Shin studied at the University of California, Riverside (B.A., 2010).
Irene Shin's listed occupation is nonprofit executive.

The House profile lists Irene Shin's committee assignments as Communications, Technology and Innovation (Vice Chair), Counties, Cities and Towns, Labor and Commerce, and Health and Human Services, and Irene Shin chairs Subcommittee #1 of Counties, Cities and Towns.
